hookLine: Ranking the most disastrous fishing fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: A stray hook nearly whacking a buddy right on the boat mid-cast.
Number 4: Losing balance and tumbling straight out of the kayak into the water.
Number 3: A massive fish yanking the angler clean overboard.
Number 2: The rod bending to its absolute breaking point fighting a monster fish.
Number 1: Accidentally reeling in a seagull instead of a fish!
